mapper.select: SELECT kbo.kingdee_user_code AS code, kbo.erp_user_id AS userId, kbo.kingdee_user_name AS userName FROM kingdee_business_operator kbo INNER JOIN sys_user_info su ON su.uid=kbo.erp_user_id INNER JOIN kingdee_user_post kup ON kup.kingdee_post_code=kbo.kingdee_post_code AND kup.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE kbo.kingdee_type=#{params.type} AND kbo.kingdee_org_code=#{orgCode} AND kup.use_org_code=#{orgCode} AND su.delete_state=1 AND su.user_state=1
